about: Holds barks: one short line each, said as Brea passes within a few metres, never a conversation. Eight sets, as W1's Saltrow sets. A set is chosen by who is speaking and by 'when'; a line is not repeated until its set is used up. Nobody here is named: the speaker label is the calling.

lines: Mind the pits, Reckoner. Every one
of them is a summer's digging.
The wall keeps the wind off the vine.
The ash keeps the rain in.
Three buckets to a pit, at dusk.
Never at noon.
You're from the Pans. You walk
like the ground is flat.
The Tillers dig, we plant.
Nobody asked them. Nobody asks us.
Vermilion on the outer wall again.
My father scrubbed it off twice.

sets.when: on the slope with the herd
lines: Stay in the lee. They never look back.
One seed to a core. Two if the
Tiller went deep.
They don't mind us. They don't
mind anything.
My bag's half empty and they've
got the whole slope to go.
Don't run. The Plumb sees running.
Five of them this year. Last year four.
Gloves on. The pads bite.
The white on the pads is the dye.
Crush it and it's carmine.
A basket of bugs for a bolt of red.
Don't laugh. It's a good trade.
The Screed cut a terrace last spring.
We picked the pads off the spoil.
Red hands till midsummer.
Nobody minds in Ninewalls.

sets.when: while the line is on the walls
lines: That paint sits at the height
the ground used to be.
Four walls painted. It wants
them cut to the stripe.
The Plumb painted it in the night.
Nobody heard a thing.
Scrub it and it comes back.
We stopped scrubbing.
My grandmother says the walls were
here before the Plumbs. She's wrong.

sets.when: while the Screed is on the walls (0:35)
lines: Off the wall! It's turning!
Get the children in the tube!
Second wall's going! Go round!
It can't turn when it runs.
Make it run!
The seals, Reckoner! On the rams!
Oro! Oro, it's at the third!
It's just standing there.
Is it dead? Can they die?
Three walls' worth of stone
to stack again. We know how.
Oro says another one will come.
You put it on its knees with a gaff.
I saw it.
The vines behind the second wall
are fine. The vines are fine.
The paint's gone. All nine walls.
I watched it go.
What did you do down at the stud?
My mother would have cried.
I might yet.
The Plumb on the terrace walked off.
Just walked off.
True ground. I didn't know
we could be.
Stack the third wall. It stays.

sets.when: at the tube mouth and the counter
lines: Cool in here. The tube runs
all the way to the Jameo.
Bronze bars for salt, salt for bars.
Oro sets the weights.
Don't touch the anvil. It's hot
longer than it looks.
The crabs in the Jameo are white.
They've never seen the sun.
Oro made that gaff for the boats.
Boats! In the Holds!
